grammar: Exact two positional arguments: {{另|main|alternative}}; no named parameters, nesting or other markup is resolved.
display_policy: Keep the source argument order and both complete readings: main〔一作「alternative」〕. Do not split an alternative containing Chinese enumeration punctuation.
raw_text_policy: Preserve the original corpus and raw verse without normalization; offsets use Python Unicode code points, zero based and end exclusive.
unresolved_policy: Keep raw text, mark unresolved_markup and set display_text to null; never issue a partially rendered quotation as resolved.
scope: Meihua verse display only; this template reading is not a collated ancient edition or a rule for choosing a prediction.
